_about: T-FFTRadNet (Giroux et al., ICCV 2023 BRAVO workshop) training recipe from the reference repo (jgiroux8/T_FFTRadNet 68bc041), RadIal/config/*_config.json and RADDet/config/*_config.json: seed 3, Adam lr 1e-4, StepLR 10 / 0.9, 150 epochs, FocalLoss + 'smoothL1Loss' (which runs plain L1, in the reference's loss code as in ours), loss weights [2, 100, 100] on RADIal (third term the freespace BCE) and [2, 100, 100000] on RADDet (third term the class map cross-entropy). Batch: RADIal 4; RADDet 16 for RD and ADC, 4 for RAD; val 4, test 1. The reference's 'asam' block is not read by its own training loop and is left out. Best checkpoint: F1 on RADIal, select_score on RADDet.
_split_note: RADIal: the reference splits by valeo's sequence lists (mode 'sequence'), which is this app's 'original' split. RADDet: the reference splits its train directory at random 0.9 / 0.1 and tests on the test directory; here the dataset's official split (original_split_info.json, 7314 train / 812 val / 2032 test) is used, the test set being the same.
_merge_note: The Train page starts from 'default' and replaces whole top-level keys with the dataset block, or with the dataset's per-feature block when one exists for the chosen feature (not both); so the RADDet 'RAD' block repeats the RADDet losses and test_checkpoint.
